title: ScaledJob `rolloutStrategy` is deprecated in favour of `rollout.strategy`
remediation: Move the value of `spec.rolloutStrategy` (gradual | immediate) to `spec.rollout.strategy` on each ScaledJob named. The old field still works on every 2.x release and has never been removed, so nothing breaks on the hop — this is the cleanup to schedule before it is.
verifyCommand: kubectl get scaledjobs.keda.sh -A -o json 2>/dev/null | jq -r '.items[] | select(.spec.rolloutStrategy != null) | "\(.metadata.namespace)/\(.metadata.name) rolloutStrategy=\(.spec.rolloutStrategy)"'  # each row still sets the deprecated field

title: Huawei Cloudeye: `minMetricValue` is documented as deprecated in favour of `activationTargetMetricValue`

detection.reason: checked on the ScaledObject/ScaledJob triggers the agent projects (trigger type + metadata KEY names, never values) — a key supplied through a TriggerAuthentication or an environment variable is not a metadata key and is not scanned

quote: Deprecated if favor of `activationTargetMetric…** — `minMetricValue` - **Deprecated if favor of `activationTargetMetricValue`** Minimum value for your metric. If the actual value of the metric you get from cloudeye is less than the minimum value, then the scaler is not active. (This value can be a float)
remediation: The 2.8 docs already mark `minMetricValue` deprecated (2.8 introduced `activationTargetMetricValue` for every scaler); the code only starts announcing it in 2.18 and refuses it in 2.20. Rename the key on each huawei-cloudeye trigger named when convenient — nothing breaks on this hop.
verifyCommand: kubectl get scaledobjects.keda.sh,scaledjobs.keda.sh -A -o json 2>/dev/null | jq -r '.items[] | . as $o | .spec.triggers[]? | select((.type == "huawei-cloudeye") and (.metadata // {} | has("minMetricValue"))) | "\($o.kind) \($o.metadata.namespace // "-")/\($o.metadata.name) trigger=\(.type)"'  # each row still uses the key the docs deprecate (refused from 2.20)
